entities.name: Dragon Scroll
entities.description: An artifact containing an obscure fire spell and a hidden map of Zendikar.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker tricked into stealing the scroll; later finds Ugin's fire.

entities.name: Ramaz
entities.description: Shaman and planeswalker who tricked Chandra into stealing the scroll.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker assigned to track the thief and erase memories of readers.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: Planeswalker who handed Chandra over, then helped her escape.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Mad planeswalker and agent of Nicol Bolas who attacks Chandra in dragon form.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon whose agent Sarkhan is.

entities.name: Sanctum of Stars
entities.description: Museum on Kephalai destroyed by Chandra's attack.

entities.name: Kephalai
entities.description: Plane holding the Sanctum of Stars.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: Chandra's home plane where Jace finds her.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: Place on Zendikar where Chandra meets Sarkhan.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Dragon whose invisible fire is hinted at in the scroll.

events.summary: Chandra is tricked by Ramaz into stealing the scroll from the Sanctum of Stars.
events.quote: Chandra Nalaar was tricked by the shaman Ramaz

events.summary: Jace tracks Chandra to Keral Keep, fights and defeats her, and leaves.
events.quote: Jace confronted her and a fight broke out.

events.summary: Chandra's attack destroys the Sanctum of Stars, killing all inside.
events.quote: her attack on a group of soldiers caused the entire Sanctum of Stars

events.summary: Gideon turns Chandra over to Kephalai's soldiers but later helps her escape.
events.quote: turned her over to the soldiers of Kephalai

events.summary: Chandra follows the map to the Eye of Ugin, where Sarkhan Vol attacks her as a dragon.
events.quote: Vol transformed himself into a dragon and attacked Chandra

events.summary: Jace and Chandra use Ugin's fire to defeat Sarkhan, triggering the last lock of the Eldrazi confinement spell.
events.quote: they unwittingly triggered the last lock of the Eldrazi confinement spell

relations.quote: Jace Beleren was assigned to track the thief
